# OpticVilla

> OpticVilla is an Indian online eyewear store offering eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, prescription ordering support, and customer rewards.

## Primary collections

- [Eyeglasses](https://www.opticvilla.com/eyeglasses)
- [Sunglasses](https://www.opticvilla.com/sunglasses)
- [Contact lenses](https://www.opticvilla.com/contact-lenses)
